tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
he firm must be registered in India with appropriate tax and other administrative authorities.

As per the Government Orders vide FD/165/EXP-12/2017 dated: 21/03/2017 and FD/539/EXP-12/2017 dated: 02/06/2017, the option of uploading documents in financial bid section is disabled. a. Only landed price shall be mentioned in e-portal which shall be inclusive of all taxes, duties, P&F, freight, other charges, etc. This dashboard price only be considered for price comparison. b. If the bidder quotes in e-portal as exclusive of taxes and become L1, then the purchase order will be made on L1 bidder considering his dashboard price as inclusive of all taxes, etc. If the bidder fails to execute the order, EMD will be forfeited.
As the Government of India has implemented Goods and Service Tax (GST) from 1st July 2017, Hence Bidders are required to quote accordingly in lieu of Taxes, Duties etc.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed.
The document submitted by bidder in kpp portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.
Other terms and conditions are as per NIT clause and any pre-counter terms and conditions will not be accepted.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully undertaken the analysis of critical minerals, major elements, Rare Earth Elements (REE), and Platinum Group Elements (PGE) from mine development/core/tailings waste dump samples pertaining to any private or government mines during the last five (5) financial years, i.e., from 2020-21 to 2024-25. The bidder shall submit the required information along with supporting documents like copy of work order.
The bidder must be a Registered legal entity in India. Copy of Registration Certificate of the laboratory.

The (bidder) should be a NABL accredited Laboratories with ISO/IEC 17025:2017 certification capable of analysing Major elements, critical minerals, REEs, PGE from mine ore/core/gold ore tailings/waste dumps samples Valid NABL certificate confirming compliance with ISO/IEC 17025:2017 clearly mentioning the scope and range of testing.

The bidders should have in the three years period i.e FY 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 achieved in at least two Financial years, the turnover per annum not less than Rs. 15 Lakhs. The turnover certificate issued by the Chartered Accountant shall be enclosed. Annual Turnover certificate of Audited Balance Sheets and P&L statement duly certified by Chartered Accountant
The bidder should have valid PAN, GST Registration. Valid PAN and GST Registration certificate

The bidder should not have been blacklisted, debarred, or banned from participation in tenders by any Central Government, State Government, Public Sector Undertaking, or any other Government organization as on the date of bid submission. Bidder should provide declaration.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate issued by the chartered Accountant for the year FY 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25
Copies of ITR for the last three years i.e. FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copies of Purchase Order/Completion Certificate/Satisfactory report as a proof for past experience
Duly filled technical bid B should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Duly filled, signed and with seal copy of NIT should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Profit & Loss statement and Balance sheet issued by the chartered Accountant for the year FY 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25
Undertaking as per Technical D should be attached and document can be downloaded from enclosures.
